title: CVE-2025-4637 — Divide By Zero in dlib
summary: Affected: davisking dlib Divide By Zero vulnerability in davisking dlib allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service via a crafted file. .This issue affects dlib: before <19.24.7.

title: CVE-2026-24799 — A heap-based buffer over-read or buffer overflow in davisking/dlib
summary: Affected: davisking dlib Out-of-bounds Write, Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input ('Classic Buffer Overflow') vulnerability in davisking dlib (dlib/external/zlib modules). This vulnerability is associated with program files inflate.C. This issue affects dlib: before v19.24.9.

title: CVE-2026-95615 — Zenitel Connect OS command injection in hiatus container via unsanitized filename in audio messages API
summary: Affected: Zenitel Connect OS command injection vulnerability in audio messages API in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 allows remote authenticated users to execute arbitrary OS commands as root in the hiatus application container via filename parameter to the /api/system/audio_messages endpoint.

title: CVE-2026-95614 — Zenitel Connect host applies rsyslog configuration written to a volume shared with the hiatus container
summary: Affected: Zenitel Connect The host configuration watcher in Zenitel Connect before 1.11.0 applies a rsyslog configuration file written to a data volume that is shared with the hiatus application container, which allows local attackers with write access to the hiatus container filesystem to execute arbitrary OS commands as root on the host operating system via a crafted rsyslog configuration file.

title: CVE-2026-95613 — Zenitel Connect pREST API adopts arbitrary PostgreSQL role from unvalidated JWT sub claim
summary: Affected: Zenitel Connect The pREST database REST API in Zenitel Connect firmware before 1.11.0 signs and verifies JWTs with the platform CA private key, which is stored on a data volume shared between containers, and sets the PostgreSQL session role from the unvalidated sub claim of each request while connected to the database as the "postgres" superuser, which allows local attackers who can read the platform CA private key from the container filesystem to execute database operations as the PostgreSQL superuser, including reading the master encryption key and password hashes, via a forged JWT with sub=postgres sent to the pREST API.

title: CVE-2026-95379 — Path traversal in Zenitel turbineweb certificate delete RPC allows arbitrary file deletion as root
summary: Affected: Zenitel VSFF6, Zenitel VSFF8, Zenitel VSFF8MP, Zenitel VSFF8MN, Zenitel VSFT Path traversal in the certificate.deleteCertificate JSON-RPC method (POST /api/rpc) of the turbineweb web interface in Zenitel VSFF6, VSFF8, VSFF8MP, VSFF8MN, and VSFT devices with software versions from 10.0.3.0 before 10.1.3.0 allows authenticated administrators to delete arbitrary files as root via a relative path (../) in the file_name parameter. This can be used to cause denial of service or render the device inoperable by removing critical system files, and to weaken device security by removing files such as firewall rules or certificate trust stores.

title: CVE-2026-95378 — Path traversal in Zenitel turbineweb certificate upload allows arbitrary file write as root
summary: Affected: Zenitel VSFF6, Zenitel VSFF8, Zenitel VSFF8MP, Zenitel VSFF8MN, Zenitel VSFT Path traversal in the certificate upload endpoint (/api/certificate/upload) of the turbineweb web interface in Zenitel VSFF6, VSFF8, VSFF8MP, VSFF8MN, and VSFT devices with software versions from 10.0.3.0 before 10.1.3.0 allows authenticated administrators to write arbitrary files as root via a crafted filename parameter in a multipart upload request when the type field is set to any value other than https_certificate. In that case, both path validation and certificate content validation are skipped. This can be escalated to arbitrary code execution as root, for example by overwriting startup scripts or planting SSH keys.

title: CVE-2026-95377 — OS command injection via DHCP option 66 in Zenitel EdgeAudioClient TFTP provisioning
summary: Affected: Zenitel VSFF6, Zenitel VSFF8, Zenitel VSFF8MP, Zenitel VSFF8MN, Zenitel VSFT OS command injection in the TFTP provisioning module of Zenitel EdgeAudioClient before 9.6.3.0, and 10.x before 10.1.3.0, on VSFF6, VSFF8, VSFF8MP, VSFF8MN, and VSFT devices allows unauthenticated adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root via a crafted DHCP option 66 (TFTP Server Name) value supplied by a rogue DHCP server on the same network segment. The DHCP-supplied value is passed to a shell without sanitization. Devices using DHCP, the default configuration, are affected on every boot and lease renewal. The same injection is also reachable via the config_update_tftp_server and sw_update_tftp_server configuration fields by an attacker able to modify the device configuration.

title: CVE-2026-86356
summary: Affected: Dell PowerStore 500T, Dell PowerStore 1000T, Dell PowerStore 1200T, Dell PowerStore 3000T, Dell PowerStore 3200Q, Dell PowerStore 3200T, Dell PowerStore 5000T, Dell PowerStore 5200Q, Dell PowerStore 5200T, Dell PowerStore 7000T and 5 more Dell PowerStore contains an authorization-bypass vulnerability that could lead to elevation of privilege to administrator.

title: CVE-2026-86355
summary: Affected: Dell PowerStore 500T, Dell PowerStore 1000T, Dell PowerStore 1200T, Dell PowerStore 3000T, Dell PowerStore 3200Q, Dell PowerStore 3200T, Dell PowerStore 5000T, Dell PowerStore 5200Q, Dell PowerStore 5200T, Dell PowerStore 7000T and 5 more Dell PowerStore contains an External Control of File Name or Path vulnerability. A remote authenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to privilege escalation on the appliance.
